_comment: Themed seed pool for the 'massive wide mountainous zone where it's all high'. Sampled by VoronoiTieredBiomeSource only when a seed's `theme` field points here. Mixes cold (jagged/frozen) and warm (stony/arid) peaks plus RU verticals (spires, towering_cliffs) so the region is visually varied across the cell. Tectonic does the elevation work — these biomes just supply surface palette and mob spawns.
